root_cause.text: The RDMA/mana error path in `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` failed to unwind vport steering/RX state configured by `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()`, causing a resource leak when later setup such as `copy_to_udata` failed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says "`mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()` is leaked, the normal destroy path cleans it up," and the patch changes the failure jump from `goto fail;` to `goto err_disable_vport_rx;` and adds `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc);` before the existing cleanup loop.

intent_record.intent_summary: Disable vport RX when RSS QP creation fails during copy-to-udata cleanup to avoid leaving RX enabled on error.
intent_record.what: The error path after a failed copy-to-udata operation in mana_ib_create_qp_rss() was changed from jumping directly to the generic fail label to jumping to a new err_disable_vport_rx label, which calls mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc) before falling through to the existing cleanup loop.
intent_record.how: At runtime, if copying RSS QP creation data to userspace fails, the function now disables vport RX before performing the rest of the cleanup, preventing the receive path from remaining enabled after an unsuccessful QP creation sequence.

grouping_result.intent: Disable vport RX when RSS QP creation fails during copy-to-udata cleanup to avoid leaving RX enabled on error.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the missing error-path unwind in mana_ib_create_qp_rss() by disabling vport RX during copy-to-udata failure cleanup, preventing the leaked vport steering/RX state described in the root cause.

candidates.rationale: On copy_to_udata failure, control jumps to the generic fail path without first unwinding the vport steering/RX state configured earlier, directly causing the leak described in the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This error-path jump sends execution to the generic failure cleanup after later setup fails, but bypasses unwinding of the vport steering/RX state previously established by mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering(), causing the resource leak described in the root cause.

bic_trace_step.reason: The relevant logic is fully visible in `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()`, so the snippet is sufficient. The vulnerable construct is present: after successfully creating RX WQ objects in the loop and then calling `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering(mdev, ndev, wq->rx_object, mana_ind_table, ind_tbl->log_ind_tbl_size, ucmd.rx_hash_key_len, ucmd.rx_hash_key);`, the function may fail later at `ret = ib_copy_to_udata(udata, &resp, sizeof(resp));` and on error it does `goto fail;`. In the `fail:` path, it only unwinds WQ objects with `mana_destroy_wq_obj(mpc, GDMA_RQ, wq->rx_object);` inside `while (i-- > 0)`, then frees `mana_ind_table` and returns. There is no call to undo the vport steering/RX state configured by `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()`. This matches the root cause: the error path after successful steering configuration leaks vport steering/RX state when later setup such as `ib_copy_to_udata` fails. Therefore the bug is present, and the fix is not yet included.
